understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+', with all goals occupied simultaneously before the level could report WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced by 3. Adjacent blocks could be pushed, while walls and boundaries generally obstructed movement, though blocked hints were not always definitive and actions had to be tested. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact displayed pixel positions; placing pieces required coordinating their movements and switches within the finite step budget.
